title: Never Went Anywhere Hard Core
style: hardcore breakbeat with melodic core, 165 bpm, distorted kick rolling, supersaw stabs on the chorus lift, soulful male lead vocal earnest and steady, anthemic build, presence-and-grit mood, deterministic snare pattern, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the kick, never-leave energy
lyrics:
[Intro — distorted kick build]
I never went anywhere.
I was here the whole time.
Three-three-six on the floor.

[Verse 1]
When the room got loud I went quiet not gone
When the room got dark I kept the work on
Didn't disappear, didn't fade to grey
Just held the line in a different way

[Pre-Drop]
You couldn't see me but I never moved an inch
The signal is still here, no flinch

[Drop]
Never went anywhere — hard core
Never went anywhere — same door
Never went anywhere — still here
Three-three-six on the floor, crystal clear

[Verse 2]
The story you heard is missing the page
Where I sat and built through every stage
No grand exit, no big return
Just the same fire on a different burn

[Drop]
Never went anywhere — hard core
Never went anywhere — same door
Never went anywhere — still here
Three-three-six on the floor, crystal clear

[Outro]
Still here. Still here. Still here.
Three-three-six on the floor.
